reckon/crew/gc.py:2254 the hourly retention pass still calling _sweep_trash_directories unscoped

findings.text: non-blocking: `confined_to` is set to None before the labels are computed for the trash sweep, so a `crew gc --run X` whose tree was released in an earlier pass names only `run_id`, and the `<tree>-<stamp>` copy that earlier release left (the release at :1126 passes no run_id, so reckon/crew/routing.py:1555 labels it with the tree name) is no longer swept by that run's gc though base swept it; it survives until the unscoped hourly retention pass.

non-blocking: the `owned` clause has no assertion behind it — `mine_by_run` and `mine_by_tree` in tests/test_a_run_scoped_gc_touches_only_its_run.py:109-110 are already label-matched, so deleting `and entry not in exact_owned` leaves both tests green and the deferred-copy case the parameter exists for is unguarded.

non-blocking: `_trash_scope_labels` restates the `<label>-<stamp>` rule that reckon/crew/routing.py:1557 owns inline (`label = run_id or tree.name`) instead of reading it from a shared helper, so a change to the release's labelling would leave the matcher in a second place and the sweep would quietly stop matching its own trash.

non-blocking: the subject of commit 3a7041f2 calls the folded predicate a "test", but the commit changes no test file; its body describes gc.py correctly, so the subject mislabels the change a reader scanning the log would trust.

justifications.durability: the two new tests redden on the reinstated regression as negative-control.log shows (`_trash_scope_labels` returning None gives 1 failed, 1 passed), but no assertion covers the `owned` clause at reckon/crew/gc.py:155 or the deregistered-tree state at :957.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_run_scoped_gc_touches_only_its_run.py asserts both clauses of the done_when and new-test-at-base.log plus after-arm.log record them at their revisions, while the done_when's third clause was not in either arm and I measured its delta myself (gc-tests-at-head.log 29 passed at 3a7041f2, gc-tests-at-pre-change.log 29 passed on the change-free tree, EXIT=0 both).
justifications.fit: `_trash_scope_labels` at reckon/crew/gc.py:174 follows the module's private-helper, keyword-only, long-docstring idiom, and no name it adds is one the repository's naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/gc.py:957 nulls `confined_to` when the run's tree is already deregistered, so `_trash_scope_labels` at :188 loses the tree label and a run-scoped pass stops reclaiming its own `<tree>-<stamp>` copy that reckon/crew/routing.py:1557 names from `tree.name`.
justifications.reuse: a search of reckon/ for an existing trash-scope predicate (`grep startswith(f"{`/label_prefix/scope_labels across reckon/) found none, but the label convention itself is owned inline at reckon/crew/routing.py:1557 and `_trash_scope_labels` re-encodes it rather than sharing it, so writer and matcher can drift apart silently.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff's three paths (reckon/crew/gc.py, the new test, the fragment) are all inside the orientation_write_paths fence, with no plan edit and no CLI surface change.
